column1: # Tools/ownership.tsv — path glob → owning area (ARCHITECTURE §1, §8; PLAN.md §3). SKEL (frozen); change only through
# Documentation/build/requests/<AREA>.md. Read by Tools/build.sh (B2_AREA mirroring, publish-green, check-ownership, lint-names).
# Format: <glob><TAB><owner>. `**` matches any depth, `*` matches within one path component. The most specific row wins:
# an exact path beats every glob; among globs the one with more literal characters wins. Two different owners at the same
# specificity for one file = doubly owned (an error). Owner ids are PLAN.md's area ids; their TAG is the id without hyphens
# (FAM-F5A → FAMF5A), which B2_AREA, green snapshots, test folders and `core-test --area` use. READONLY and NOBODY are
# not areas: nothing edits those paths (Tools/calibrate, Tools/workflows, the binding documents, research and design).
# --- SKEL (walking skeleton; frozen after the gate)
